facts.business: Annvrridhhi Ventures Limited (formerly J. Taparia Projects Limited) undertook rights issue processes for capital raising during the year.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties during FY2026 included remuneration to Mr. Sarvesh Manmohan Agrawal (Promoter, Chairman and Managing Director) of Rs 26.00 lakhs, reimbursement of company expenses of Rs 1.65 lakhs, and sitting fees to independent directors Ms. Bhoomi Ketan Talati (Rs 0.90 lakhs), Mr. Tarunkumar Bhagwandas Sukhwani (Rs 0.80 lakhs), Mr. Navinchandra Dilipsinh Bochare (Rs 1.00 lakhs), and Ms. Bhavana Hamirbhai (Rs 0.30 lakhs). Reimbursement of membership expenses to Mr. Tarunkumar Bhagwandas Sukhwani of Rs 0.30 lakhs. All transactions were at arm's length basis.
